# farm-comfyui (worker image mirror)

Public build mirror for a RunPod serverless ComfyUI worker (Wan 2.2 TI2V-5B
image-to-video). Exists so the image `ghcr.io/slzwei/farm-comfyui` is
anonymously pullable by RunPod.

**Do not edit here.** Source of truth is the private farm repo's `runpod/` +
`workflows/` directories — changes are synced into this mirror and rebuilt
by `.github/workflows/build.yml`.

See `runpod/README.md` for what the worker does and how it is deployed.
